title: SentinelCloud — System Health
description: Whole-platform health: availability, golden signals, resources, event pipeline, Kubernetes pods and alerts.

options.content:
### SentinelCloud — System Health
One screen for the whole platform: **are services up, are they fast, are they failing, are events flowing, is Kubernetes healthy?** Green/yellow/orange/red follow the same four-tier scale as the Command Center. Kubernetes-only panels (pods, restarts, limits) show *No data* under Docker Compose. Drill down via the **SentinelCloud dashboards** menu (top right).

panels.title: Services up (of 8)
panels.description: Services with at least one healthy, scrapeable instance.

panels.title: Critical alerts
panels.description: Firing alerts with severity=critical (details in the Alerts table below).

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: API requests per second across all services (health probes and scrapes excluded), 5-minute rate.

panels.title: Error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Share of API requests answered with HTTP 5xx. Alert threshold: 5%.

panels.title: API latency p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile request duration across all services. Alert threshold: 1s per service.

panels.title: RabbitMQ
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can reach the broker.

panels.title: Event latency p95
panels.description: Publish → handled, across every consumer (e.g. disaster.detected → hospital reaction). Alert threshold: 5s.

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Kubernetes only: pods failing their readiness probe (no traffic routed to them).

panels.title: Container restarts (1h)
panels.description: Kubernetes only: container restarts in the last hour (crashes, OOM kills, failed liveness probes).

panels.title: Live dashboard clients
panels.description: Browsers connected to the /ws/live feed, summed across notification-service replicas.

panels.title: Service up/down
panels.description: Green = Prometheus can scrape the service (at least one instance), red = it can't. Gaps = no data.

panels.title: Dependencies as seen by each service
panels.description: sentinel_dependency_up: can each service reach Postgres / RabbitMQ / Redis right now? (The same checks as its readiness probe.)

panels.title: API golden signals — traffic, errors, latency
5xx error ratio by service
panels.description: Dashed line = 5% alert threshold (SentinelHighErrorRate).

panels.title: p95 latency by service
panels.description: Dashed line = 1s alert threshold (SentinelHighApiLatency).

panels.title: CPU by service (cores)
panels.description: CPU cores used, reported by each process itself (works in Compose and Kubernetes). 1.0 = one full core.

panels.title: Memory by service (RSS)
panels.description: Resident memory, summed across replicas.

panels.title: CPU used / limit, per pod (Kubernetes)
panels.description: Above 100% the container is throttled. Dashed line = 85% alert threshold (SentinelHighCpu).

panels.title: Memory used / limit, per pod (Kubernetes)
panels.description: At 100% the container is OOM-killed. Dashed line = 90% alert threshold (SentinelHighMemory).

panels.title: Event latency p95 (publish → handled)
panels.description: End-to-end: the publisher's occurredAt timestamp until the consumer finished. Dashed line = 5s alert threshold.

panels.title: Queue depth (ready messages)
panels.description: Messages waiting for a consumer. A growing line = consumers falling behind. Dashed line = 100 (SentinelQueueBacklog).

panels.title: Ready replicas per deployment
panels.description: Watch this during `kubectl scale` or an HPA scale-up.

panels.title: Pods not Running/Ready
panels.description: Empty = every pod is Running and Ready.

targets.expr: (max by (pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="sentinelcloud"}) == 1 unless on (pod) max by (pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="sentinelcloud", phase="Running"}) == 1) or on (pod) label_replace(max by (pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="sentinelcloud", condition="false"}) == 1, "phase", "Running (not ready)", "", "")

panels.title: Firing and pending alerts
panels.description: From Prometheus' ALERTS series. Silences and grouping: Alertmanager UI. Empty = all clear.

panels.title: Resilience drill stage
panels.description: While a Resilience Demo drill runs (frontend → Resilience Demo), its stage lines up in time with the restart, replica and error graphs above.

panels.title: Drills completed / failed
panels.description: Resilience drills that reached RESTORED on their own.

panels.title: Drills not completed
panels.description: Aborted, or the platform did not recover within the drill's time limit.

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Events that failed every retry (or weren't valid events), parked in q.dead-letters instead of being dropped. Anything above 0 fires SentinelDeadLetters. List: GET /api/v1/notifications/dead-letters; replay: POST …/dead-letters/replay.

panels.title: Outbox backlog by service
panels.description: Events saved in a service's outbox and not yet confirmed by RabbitMQ. Normally 0; it rises while RabbitMQ is unreachable and drains on its own when it's back. Above 0 for 2 minutes fires SentinelOutboxBacklog.

panels.title: Events failed after retries / min, by queue
panels.description: Events a consumer gave up on after its retries (outcome error/invalid), so they went to the dead-letter queue. 0 when healthy.
